name: Astrid Karlsson
bio:
Astrid's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood summers spent watching rally races in the Swedish countryside. She pursued a degree in engineering management, determined to combine her technical aptitude with her leadership aspirations. Her first role was as a junior data analyst for a Formula 3 team, where she quickly proved her ability to identify performance bottlenecks and propose innovative solutions.

Driven by a desire to contribute to a team's overall strategy, Astrid transitioned into operations. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their unique skills. Her approach is data-driven, yet she values intuition and creative problem-solving. Astrid is eager to prove herself as a dynamic and forward-thinking head of operations, focused on optimizing efficiency and driving innovation within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight blonde hair often pulled back into a high ponytail.
physical.description: Astrid is a slender woman with a focused gaze and a perpetually energetic demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of pacing while on phone calls.
Prefers to conduct brainstorming sessions standing up to encourage more dynamic thinking.
